title: Enrollment in the Personal Services Plan — Eligible Residents, Start Date and Signatures
content:
Personal Services Plan enrollment is open to Larkspur residents only, and the Resident and Family Services desk applies the following rules on who may enroll, when a plan starts, and who may sign.

## 1. Who may enroll

The resident's residence must be an independent living residency or an assisted living residency whose status is active or notice given, and the residence category must be one the chosen tier lists among its eligible residence categories. Assisted living residents may therefore hold only the Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan, the Personal Services Essentials Package or the Personal Services Companion Package. Memory care residents and respite or trial stay guests cannot enroll, because their care and services are covered under their own agreements.

The test rests on the residency records, matched to the resident enrolling — not on the caller's description of the residence.

| Residence on record | Status on record | Tiers open |
|---|---|---|
| Independent living residency | Active or notice given | All six tiers |
| Assisted living residency | Active or notice given | Pay-As-You-Go Plan, Essentials Package, Companion Package |
| Memory care residency | — | None |
| Respite or trial stay | — | None |

## 2. When a plan starts

A plan starts on the first day of a calendar month, the tier's enrollment effective day: the first day of the month after the enrollment is signed, or a later month the resident chooses. Hypothetical illustration: an enrollment signed on 14 March starts on 1 April, or on the first day of a later month if the resident chooses one.

## 3. Withdrawal before the start

An enrollment may be withdrawn by the resident at any time before its effective date, without charge.

## 4. Who signs

The enrollment, any withdrawal and any cancellation must be signed by the resident, or by a representative whose authority on the resident's record is a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or a guardianship. The authority is read from the resident's record.

## Points of judgement

- An assisted living resident asking for the Comfort, Premier or Concierge Package is outside the eligible residence categories of those tiers.
- A representative recorded with an authority other than the three listed does not sign an enrollment, a withdrawal or a cancellation.
